sourceDistinctions: The printed line gives AC 16 from +4 size/+2 Dexterity but lists touch 14 and flat-footed 12. Standard arithmetic yields touch 16 and flat-footed 14. The record retains the printed line.

The Bat Swarm table explicitly lists half damage from slashing and piercing. The shared subtype gives all-weapon immunity to Diminutive swarms. Wizards of the Coast’s 17 February 2006 Monster Manual v3.5 errata supports weapon immunity for play. The archive’s older line remains in evidence.

errata.effect: The publisher clarifies that bat and spider swarms are immune to weapon damage. This supports the shared subtype rule as the table choice for the older SRD entry.
